summary: This feature profiles five local entrepreneurs whose businesses have strengthened the city's economy: Erica Johnson (Preserve Passion), David Mwangi (Pixel Perfect), Amanda Chen (Verdant Views), Chef Marcus Reid (Reid's Bistro) and Diana Rodrigues (Wheels of Fortune). Each story highlights perseverance, community programs and sustainability, and the piece closes by noting that these narratives continue to evolve and inspire the next generation of entrepreneurs.
one_line: Profiles of five local entrepreneurs in food, design, gardening, dining and cycling who built businesses and community programs in the city.
key_facts: Erica Johnson, a single mother of two, started her business in October 2023 and turned a kitchen hobby into the preserves brand "Preserve Passion".

Preserve Passion uses natural ingredients and traditional techniques, with flavors such as Spiced Pear and Raspberry-Rose, sold at local farmers' markets and high-end specialty stores across the city.
David Mwangi runs "Pixel Perfect", a digital design studio whose three-year anniversary was September 10, 2023; he began by freelancing from a cramped studio apartment.
David Mwangi offers mentorship programs and workshops for youth interested in graphic design, which grew from a small community initiative into a talent incubator.
Amanda Chen opened "Verdant Views", an urban gardening center, on November 12, 2023, turning a once-vacant rooftop space into a sustainability haven.
Amanda Chen has a background in environmental science and landscape design and runs community gardening projects and educational workshops.
Chef Marcus Reid opened "Reid's Bistro" on September 15, 2023, after starting out as a dishwasher in a run-down diner and working in prestigious kitchens across the country.
Reid's Bistro celebrates local flavors with fine dining without pomposity and runs "Chef in the Making" programs for young cooks from challenging backgrounds.
Diana Rodrigues created "Wheels of Fortune" after a bicycle accident in September 2023, when she saw a market gap for high-quality, affordable bicycles.
Wheels of Fortune offers innovative financing options and maintenance workshops, fostering a community of cyclists and environmental advocates.
The piece states it has no conclusion and says the profiles only scratch the surface of local business success stories.
